title: parseToml(readProjectToml()) and resolveIssueId run once per filing batch even …
description:
parseToml(readProjectToml()) and resolveIssueId run once per filing batch even when candidates is empty (no suggestions to file). Negligible cost, but the two lines could sit inside the candidates.length > 0 guard to avoid a project.toml read on empty batches.

Source: cam/issue-263
Review round: 1
Location: src/commands/sidecar.ts:2246

suggestion-fingerprint: ac708b73294a

acceptanceCriteria: When candidates is empty (candidates.length === 0), readProjectToml/parseToml is not called.
All-duplicates path (candidates empty, dupSkipped > 0) still emits the suggestion-filed logEvent with { filedIds: [], dupSkipped: N, failedCount: 0 }.
Non-empty candidates: behavior is unchanged: each candidate is filed with derivedFrom: [parentIssueId] when parentIssueId resolves.
spec.scope: In makeProductionFileSuggestionsFn (src/commands/sidecar.ts), wrap the config/prefix/parentIssueId resolution and the candidate-filing for-loop inside a candidates.length > 0 guard, so an empty batch (no suggestions to file) skips the project.toml read. The post-loop suggestion-filed logEvent block stays outside the guard: it fires on dupSkipped > 0, which is independent of candidates.
gotchas: The guard must wrap ONLY the toml read + for-loop, never the logEvent block: otherwise the all-duplicates path (candidates empty but dupSkipped > 0) stops emitting its event.
src-only change: no edit under templates/ or agents/, so no bun run embed-vendor / embedded byte-parity concern.
